main_text.l: commendabat nobis,qui iustitiæ imaginem expressurā[?]
feminibus[?] oculorum ut acrioribus, ita etiam rectis & im-
motis pingere studuerit: quo nimirum significaret, ma-
gistratum nullius gratiam præferre debere iustis legibus,
sed in improbos severum & inexorabilem, in probos mi-
tem & mansuetum esse oportere. Hac enim via, inquit,
dum ingrederentur maiores olim nostri, adversus mul-
tas simul aut motas aut suspectas immutationes rerum,
se & civitatem hanc suam munierunt servaruntque.
Ceterum ne ad formandos optimos cuique mores recta
desint studia, utque non tam privatam quam publicam
patriæ quoque salutem tueri contendant cives, ac subin-
de novam semper patriæ gloriam comparare studeant:
ad ea duntaxat adjiciendus est animus studia, quæ bono-
rum omnium consensu ad virtutem sunt accommoda-
tissima: Quo in ordine vel primas obtinet historia, ex
qua tanquam oraculo civilia petenda censemus institu-
ta. [illegible, ~10 letters] : Nemo bonus fidem & sedulitatem
avunculi vestri Bilibaldi Pirckheymeri, viri incompa-
rabilis & rectissimi iudicii, iure improbare poterit: quando
in hoc unum respexit, ut labore suo prodesset multis, ut ad
virtutes, animi ornamenta, invitaret quam plurimos.
Hæc delectatio illius, hoc gaudiu, hoc desideriu fuit, &c.

l.bl: Das lautet vngefehr inn angeregter vnser Mut-
tersprach/wie folget: Glaubt mir Darumb/so hoch
ist ein jedweder im Regiment zu halten / als wol
er sich mit vernunfft vnd Tugend erweiset. Vnd
Der jenige / so andern zum Regenten fürgesetzet/
wird zu gleich allen Bürgern mit anderst als ein
wird/ wo er nicht dieselbige Hoheit / zu deren er
also erhaben / mit seinen eignen Tugenden etli-
cher massen noch mehr zu orniren sich befleissiget.
Wil em Obrigkeit gehorsame Bürger vñ Vnter-thanen

page.notes: Greek name at the start of the Latin passage (before the colon) is not legible at this scan; left as illegible. "feminibus" is uncertain (first letter may be f or long s); marked [?]. "expressurā" final letter uncertain; marked [?]. "Wil em" in the black-letter line: the first word is uncertain. The black-letter block is marked with bl because it is German inside a Latin page. The German last line is underlined on the scan (underline not transcribed). The "ʒ" in "zu" is transcribed as z. Printed "adjiciendus", "gaudiu", "desideriu", "orniren" are left as printed. A stray printer's mark at the top right and a dot in the left margin are not text and are omitted.
